audiences.name: Wholesalers
audiences.summary: Motivated sellers in your pipeline every week.
audiences.headline: More motivated sellers. Less time on the phone.
audiences.title: Seller Acquisition Teams for Wholesalers | VoloLeads
audiences.description: VoloLeads finds, calls and qualifies motivated sellers for wholesalers, with trained callers, fresh skip-traced lists, CRM setup and comps.
audiences.lede: Wholesaling runs on seller conversations. We find, call and qualify motivated sellers so you can spend your time on offers, contracts and buyers.

challenges.title: Not enough conversations
challenges.text: Cold calling is a volume game, and few wholesalers can dial all day and still run their deals.

challenges.title: Callers who don't last
challenges.text: Hiring, training and managing VAs takes time, and an unmanaged caller's numbers drop fast.

challenges.title: Leads without context
challenges.text: A "hot lead" with no notes means another call just to learn the basics.

challenges.title: Stale lists
challenges.text: Calling the same old records burns hours on wrong numbers and owners with no reason to sell.

services.text: A trained caller and a VA manager who qualify every seller on Motivation, Timeline, Condition and Price.
Public-record and FSBO lists, skip traced and cleaned, pulled every month on Growth and Scale.
Pipelines and follow-up automations so no motivated seller slips through.
Comps, repair estimates and MAO/LAO math as soon as a lead is qualified.

steps.title: Leads in your CRM

audiences.summary: Off-market deals without running a call floor.
audiences.headline: Off-market deals without running a call floor.
audiences.title: Off-Market Seller Leads for Real Estate Investors | VoloLeads
audiences.description: VoloLeads runs seller outreach for fix-and-flip, buy-and-hold and creative-finance investors: targeted lists, trained callers, comps and consulting.
audiences.lede: Whether you flip, hold or buy on terms, the best deals come from talking to owners before a property is listed. We run that outreach for you, with a manager who reports back every day.
audiences.challengeTitle: Why off-market buying is hard to scale

challenges.title: Competing on the MLS
challenges.text: Listed properties come with retail prices and a crowd of other buyers.

challenges.title: No time to prospect
challenges.text: Projects, tenants and closings leave little time for daily seller calls.

challenges.title: A calling team is its own business
challenges.text: Hiring, scripts, dialers, QA and reporting add up quickly.

challenges.title: Every lead needs numbers
challenges.text: Comps and repair estimates take hours if you run them on every lead yourself.

services.text: Lists built around distress and motivation signals, skip traced and cleaned before anyone dials.
Trained callers who find owners ready to sell and capture what you need to judge the deal.
Comparable sales, repair estimates based on square footage and offer math on qualified leads.
Market selection and deal reviews with operators who run acquisition teams every day.

audiences.name: Agents
audiences.summary: Seller conversations that turn into listings.
audiences.headline: Seller conversations that turn into listings.
audiences.title: Listing Appointment Setting for Real Estate Agents | VoloLeads
audiences.description: VoloLeads callers work expired, FSBO and pre-foreclosure lists for real estate agents and book seller appointments on your calendar.
audiences.lede: Listings start with homeowners who need to sell. Our callers work your seller lists and book appointments on your calendar, so you can spend your time with clients.

challenges.title: Prospecting eats the day
challenges.text: Calling expired and FSBO lists takes hours you'd rather spend at appointments.

challenges.title: Follow-up slips
challenges.text: Many sellers aren't ready on the first call, and follow-up is easy to lose track of.

challenges.title: Admin piles up
challenges.text: Listing paperwork, scheduling and inbox management pull you away from clients.

challenges.title: Inquiries go cold
challenges.text: Buyer and seller inquiries cool off fast without a quick response.

services.text: Callers work your expired, FSBO and pre-foreclosure lists and book interested sellers on your calendar.
Trained VAs for follow-up, scheduling, listing admin and inbox management.
A CRM that tracks every seller and buyer conversation with clear next steps.
AI connectors that cut data entry and reporting around your calls.

steps.title: Plan the outreach
steps.text: Agree on your lists, market and appointment criteria.

steps.title: Call and qualify
steps.text: Callers start seller conversations and confirm interest in listing.

steps.title: Book the appointment
steps.text: Interested sellers are scheduled on your calendar, with notes.
